preconditions_met.evidence_summary: BTE-025 identifies highest-fidelity candidates, records weaker-fidelity claim limits, and keeps source selection/backfill gated by BTE-022 and BTE-027.
The PMXT Polymarket sample contract records row shapes, bounded grouping evidence, and unresolved NT mapping gates before implementation or broad backfill.
BTE-022 remains open for binary-option L2 until NT Polymarket parser reuse, ParquetDataCatalog read-back, and BacktestNode consumption are proven.
BTE-026 records AWS/provider cost baselines and PMXT Polymarket one-year byte/cost extrapolation.

slow_backfill_root_cause_evidence.primary_risk: Broad binary-option L2 archives are large enough that downloading before proof repeats the previous inefficient backfill pattern.
row_shape_compute_risk: The full one-hour PMXT sample has 64,768,138 price_change rows.
Grouping by market and source timestamp yields 32,066,846 groups, with 31,981,978 multi-row groups.
A safe converter cannot stream each flattened row as an independent NT batch; it must group by source contract before catalog write.

approved_cost_cut_levers.rule: Build source coverage and byte ledgers from indexes/manifests before downloading raw payloads.
saves: conversion work on uncovered or unaccepted windows
storage of raw objects outside accepted scope

approved_cost_cut_levers.rule: The next binary-option L2 run is capped to one verified hourly PMXT Polymarket object until NT catalog read-back and BacktestNode consumption are proven.
Convert only accepted source-proof tranches into NT catalog data.

approved_cost_cut_levers.lever: NT-native projection and read-back as the expansion gate
approved_cost_cut_levers.rule: Use NautilusTrader data classes, ParquetDataCatalog, and BacktestNode as the proof boundary; do not build a custom simulator or custom catalog path to save time.
required_evidence_before_expansion: BacktestNode consumption of the same catalog path

approved_cost_cut_levers.rule: Use metadata, object indexes, schema samples, and bounded DuckDB checks for proof; avoid full-history group-bys or scans unless they are explicitly budgeted benchmark runs.

Keep current proof objects active/queryable, but move non-current raw and catalog artifacts through configured active/archive/deep_archive profiles only after proof status and restore cost are explicit.

explicit_non_levers.non_lever: downgrade fidelity to trades/bars for execution-quality claims
explicit_non_levers.reason: Lower-fidelity sources must carry claim limits; they cannot be used to save cost while claiming L2 replay, queue position, fillability, liquidity, or execution-quality behavior.

explicit_non_levers.non_lever: hardcode venue or provider names in production logic
explicit_non_levers.reason: Source choice must come from accepted source-proof state, config-owned source bindings, data family, fidelity, NT mapping, and cost proof.
Local prototype conversion or raw row inspection does not prove BacktestNode can consume the resulting data.
The PMXT Polymarket v2 estimate is multi-terabyte per year before conversion and validation scans.

explicit_non_levers.non_lever: treat cheaper provider fee as source selection
explicit_non_levers.reason: Provider fee is only one input; license, coverage, schema, storage, fidelity, NT mapping, and result-contract proof still gate source selection.

current_decision.next_allowed_work: Implement or further prove the one-object PMXT Polymarket NT mapping/read-back path only after the dependency-boundary scope is explicitly accepted.
